text.en: Visual Curator can select a Codex image account or a configured OpenAI API key and its available image model for each new crop batch; official-key images are reviewed at their native resolution without super-resolution.
text.zh-CN: Visual Curator 可为新裁剪批次选择 Codex 生图账号，或已配置的 OpenAI API Key 及其可用模型；官方 Key 生成图按原生分辨率复审，不再超分。
